description: Request body sent from the wireframe editor to the export API.

members.name: FileName
members.description: Desired output file name without extension.

members.name: Svg
members.description: SVG markup string (already cleaned of UI overlays).

members.name: Theme
members.description: The stencil theme the posted Svg was drawn with (indigo, indigo-dark, ...), or null for the default tokens. The browser has already drawn the SVG with it, so the server rasterises it as it is; the name travels with the request so a server can log it and keep the file in step with the canvas (decision WIREFRAME-STENCIL-THEME).
